title: Civic Notice: The Count
description: An automated Snazzie FM Civic Notification System bulletin. The pigeons on the wires have been re-designated as Census Personnel, and your block came back one short again.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> The birds on the wires of your block are no longer birds. They are Census Personnel. They are counting you.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If a bird on the wire is facing your window, please remain in view until it looks away. <p:0.3> Do not make it count you twice.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: When the flock lifts from the wire all at once, the count for your block is complete. <p:0.3> Step outside and wait to be confirmed.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> The count came back one short again. The birds will return at dusk to find the resident who was not standing outside.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> This concludes the test. Please remain in view.
